T-001.root_cause: Webhook retry after a delivery timeout re-processed payment.succeeded without an idempotency key, charging the invoice twice.

T-002.root_cause: The API key is shared with a nightly batch sync job, which uses up the per-minute rate limit.

T-003.root_cause: The identity provider's SAML signing certificate expired on 2026-09-28 and metadata was never refreshed.

T-004.root_cause: The export query does a full table scan on orders for large accounts and exceeds the 30s gateway timeout.

T-005.root_cause: VAT ID validation timed out, so billing treated the ID as unverified and fell back to a 0% rate.

T-006.root_cause: The customer's endpoint returned HTTP 410 repeatedly, so the subscription was auto-disabled after 50 failures.

T-007.root_cause: The users' addresses are on the email suppression list after an earlier hard bounce, so reset emails are never sent.

T-008.root_cause: The upload exceeds the 250MB request limit at the proxy, so finalizing the upload returns 413.

T-009.root_cause: The admin invite had expired, so the user was given the default member role, which lacks billing access.

T-010.root_cause: Indexer workers were paused by a deploy and resumed at concurrency 1 instead of 8, leaving a 4 hour indexing backlog.

T-011.root_cause: The Slack OAuth token was revoked, so posts fail with token_revoked and the integration is unhealthy.

T-012.root_cause: The nightly sync outran its 900s lock lease, so a second run started in parallel and inserted the same contacts again.

T-013.root_cause: A config change raised the aggregate cache TTL to 24 hours, so dashboards serve stale cached aggregates.

T-014.root_cause: Version 5.2.0 calls an API that older Android versions do not have, which crashes the app on launch there.

T-015.root_cause: The report filters on segment seg_88, which was deleted, so the report returns zero rows.

T-016.root_cause: An admin rotated the API key and the old secret was revoked, so requests with the old secret return 401.

T-017.root_cause: Two alert rules (rule_12 and rule_31) have the same condition and recipient, and deduplication is per rule, so each alert is sent twice.

T-018.root_cause: The CSV is UTF-8 without a byte order mark, so Excel assumes a legacy encoding and garbles accented characters.

T-019.root_cause: The users' devices have clocks that are more than a minute off, outside the 30 second TOTP window, so valid codes are rejected.

T-020.root_cause: Soft-deleted files in the trash still count toward quota for 30 days, which accounts for almost all of the used storage.
